fields.name: name
fields.description: The descriptive label for this item.

fields.name: parentId
fields.description: Reference to the parent tag in the hierarchy; empty marks a root.

fields.name: color
fields.description: A visual identifier, often used for categorization.

fields.name: count
fields.description: The number of items associated with this entry.

events.name: SELECT_TAG
events.description: Signals a tag has been chosen for navigation.

events.name: TagLoaded
events.description: Signals that the tag data has been successfully retrieved.

events.name: TagLoadFailed
events.description: Indicates failure to load tag data.

events.name: TagSelected
events.description: Signals a tag has been chosen for further exploration.

events.name: NEW_TAG
events.description: Opens the create-tag form (rendered only when allowEdit is on); the creation lands at the level currently open.
events.synonyms: add tag, create category, new category

events.name: COMMIT_TAG
events.description: The new-category form committed; data carries the name and the parent level.

events.name: CANCEL_TAG
events.description: The new-category form was dismissed without creating.

events.name: LEVEL_RELOAD
events.description: Internal hop that refetches the open level after the new-category form closes (a fetch filter cannot read trait state, so the level travels by payload).

events.name: TagCreated
events.description: A new tag row persisted; the open level refetches to show it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Allow editing
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render the create-tag affordance: creations land at the level currently open (top level, or inside the drilled-into category). Rename is a follow-up (ledgered).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Create-button label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Label on the create affordance and its form heading — say what this taxonomy calls its entries (New tag, New category, New topic).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: add label, new tag label, create caption

overridableConfigKeys.label: Back-to-root label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Label on the back affordance that returns from a drilled-in level to the root — phrase it in this taxonomy's vocabulary (All tags, All categories).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: back label, root caption, all label

overridableConfigKeys.label: Table look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for the data table rendered by this atom.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Section title
overridableConfigKeys.description: Heading shown above the tag tree
